# 09 Render control-flow block frames, branch dividers, and rect background highlight

## Outcome

`renderSequenceToSVG` renders one `<g class="siren-block" data-siren-id="{id}"
data-siren-block-kind="{kind}">` per block: a `<rect class="siren-block-frame">` at its computed
bounding box, a `<text class="siren-block-label">` for its header condition, one
`<line class="siren-block-divider">` + `<text class="siren-block-label">` per branch after the
first, and (for `rect` blocks specifically) a filled background rect using its color, drawn behind
everything else in its y-range rather than an outlined frame.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A `loop`/`alt`/`opt`/`par`/`critical`/`break` block renders its frame `<rect>` at exactly
  its `PositionedBlock` bounding box, with its condition label positioned at the top-left per
  Mermaid's own visual convention.
- [ ] An `alt`/`par`/`critical` block with N branches renders N-1 divider lines, each with its own
  branch label.
- [ ] A `rect rgb(191, 223, 255)` block renders a filled `<rect>` using that color as `fill`, with
  no visible frame border (distinct visual treatment from the other six block kinds, per
  Mermaid), positioned behind its contained messages in paint order.
- [ ] Nested blocks render as nested `<g class="siren-block">` elements, each visually enclosing
  its children (frame border ordering doesn't obscure inner content).
- [ ] All block/branch label text via `textContent` only.

## Test seam

`renderSequenceToSVG(diagram: PositionedSequenceDiagram): SVGSVGElement` — component test under
jsdom, extending ticket 04's fixtures with block-bearing `PositionedSequenceDiagram` fixtures.
